skills.name: Orchestra (管弦奏)
skills.description: Luka attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Echoing Chords (和音回响)
skills.line: Music notes will dispel your sorrow.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. For every 3 debuffs or control effects inflicted on non-summoned allies, Luka gains 1 Chord stack (can gain up to 5 stacks before the start of turn). ;Chord (和音) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. After an ally's or enemy's turn, consumes 1 stack to dispel 2 debuffs or control effects from a non-summoned ally (priority is given to allies with control effects). ;Resonance Wall (共鸣之墙) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 2 stacks. Can absorb crit damage, each stack can absorb damage equal to their own initial RES x 8000 of the damage.

upgrades.text: When a control effect on her disappears, her SPD is increased by 40, lasts for 1 turn.
For every 40% of initial RES she has, she gains 10% of damage reduction.
When Chord is consumed, also grants Resonance Wall, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Rhythm Parade (律动巡游)
skills.line: The center stage belongs to me.
skills.description: Luka dispels 1 debuff or control effect from all allies and grants them Resonance Wall, lasts for 2 turns. ;Chord (和音) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. After an ally's or enemy's turn, consumes 1 stack to dispel 2 debuffs or control effects from a non-summoned ally (priority is given to allies with control effects). ;Resonance Wall (共鸣之墙) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 2 stacks. Can absorb crit damage, each stack can absorb damage equal to their own initial RES x 8000 of the damage.

upgrades.text: Upon usage, if an ally is still inflicted with a control effect, increases their move bar by 30%.

bio.condition: With Luka clear any zone 30 times.
